Why: EP4 raises cAMP and sensitises nociceptors
Note: Deleting EP4 in peripheral nerves lessens OA pain, and PGE2 from subchondral bone sensitises DRG neurons through EP4. On macrophages EP4 also suppresses chemokines (Takayama 2002), an anti-inflammatory side not drawn here.
